The '''Kashyyyk Royal City''' was an important center on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], located near the [[Western Forest]]. It was in the Royal City that a Wookiee council met at the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to discuss what course of action the planet should take in the conflict.
